thread:
devon: FYI customer (Acct 8421) reports sudden 429 spikes from /v1/rerank starting ~11:02 UTC. They say it worked fine yesterday and the failures coincided with a deploy. Error body they pasted:

devon: ```json
{ \"error\": \"rate_limit_exceeded\", \"detail\": \"requests_per_minute exceeded for key sk-***\", \"code\": 429 }
```

devon: They also sent response headers from a failed call: `x-rw-remaining: 0`, `x-rw-limit: 800`, `x-rw-reset: 2026-03-15T11:03:00Z`, X-Request-ID `req_61a2f`.

anya: Can you paste the exact curl and approximate concurrency? Rerank is often small-payload high-QPS so the quota burn is surprising.

devon: Sanitized curl:

devon: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \ \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \ \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ \ 
  -d '{"query":"top docs","candidates":["id1","id2","id3"],"top_k":5}'
```

devon: They said ~120 concurrent short requests normally, each call 5-20 candidates. No code changes on their side.

kai: Infra metrics show a 6x jump in rerank QPS starting 10:58 UTC for ~4m. The quota counter for the shared inference bucket hit zero which will 429 all incoming rerank calls.

kai: Important: rerank and embeddings are currently mapped to the same quota bucket (inference_request). Yesterday's quota rollout increased text-gen limits but the mapping for rerank was excluded due to a config mismatch.

marcus: Confirmed: a typo in the quota mapping table (`reranking` instead of `rerank`) meant rerank endpoints weren't included in PR #1543. Text-gen got bumped, rerank did not.

sara: Is this an account-specific issue? Or will other customers see this?

kai: Others with similar high-QPS rerank patterns could hit the same. The spike was customer-driven but the root cause is our mapping so it's on us.

lem-billing: I can push a temporary quota override now for Acct 8421 (+60% rerank allowance) if support requests it. Will note a 24h expiry. Override id QOV-8421-0315.

anya: Short-term mitigation: 1) Ask customer to throttle concurrency to ~30-40 while we remediate. 2) Recommend exponential backoff + jitter for 429s. 3) Apply emergency override (lem-billing).

devon: Customer pushed a hotfix reducing concurrency and immediately saw failures subside, but they want confirmation it was our throttle and a timeline for permanent fix.

kai: Repro steps for eng/support to validate locally:

kai: 1) Use a test key with default quota.
2) Spawn 100+ short-lived workers hitting /v1/rerank with 5-10 candidates and small think time (50ms).
3) Observe 429s once the shared counter is exhausted.

kai: Minimal stress script (python) to reproduce:

kai: ```python
# stress-rerank.py
import requests,concurrent.futures
URL='https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank'
HEAD={'Authorization':'Bearer sk-TEST','Content-Type':'application/json'}
PAY={'query':'x','candidates':['a']*6,'top_k':5}

def call():
  r=requests.post(URL,json=PAY,headers=HEAD,timeout=5)
  return r.status_code, r.headers.get('x-rw-remaining')

with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=120) as e:
  futures=[e.submit(call) for _ in range(800)]
  for f in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
    print(f.result())
```

marcus: I'll patch the quota mapping in the deploy pipeline (fix the key name), add unit tests to prevent regressions, and roll the change ASAP.

lem-billing: Override applied (QOV-8421-0315). It should propagate in ~30s. Please confirm with the customer.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-00412 created and linked to support ticket S-8421. Assigned to @kai and @marcus.

devon: Customer confirmed within 60s that 429s dropped to near-zero. They still reported occasional single-digit 429s for a couple minutes while caches warmed.

anya: We'll prepare an RCA for the account and a short customer-facing summary. Draft notes: what happened, impact, root cause (quota mapping typo), mitigation (override + mapping fix), follow-ups (unit tests, quota telemetry).

marcus: Mapping PR pushed and merged. Deploy started at 11:19 UTC. Added CI unit test that asserts all endpoint keys are covered in quota table.

kai: Added a dashboard tile for rerank quota consumption and an alert at 80% sustained for 1m. Also created a synthetic load job to run hourly in staging to detect quota mapping regressions.

lem-billing: I'll keep the override until tomorrow and coordinate with account team to set a permanent quota if needed.

sara: Suggested longer-term change: give rerank its own quota bucket separate from embeddings so a single product change doesn't unintentionally affect both. Filing a policy ticket.

anya: Follow-ups (owners):
- devon: send the customer summary email + timeline (done)
- marcus: verify deploy logs and CI results (done)
- kai: dashboard + synthetic job (done)
- lem-billing: confirm override expiry and coordinate account limits (in progress)
- anya: draft full RCA and attach stress scripts + sample request_ids (in progress)

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-00412 status -> mitigated. Postmortem queued.

devon: Customer acknowledged the summary and will monitor. Thanks team.

anya: Note for support docs: add a KB entry on handling rerank 429s explaining shared quota behavior and suggested client-side backoff patterns with example code.

marcus: Closing note: be careful with quota table keys in config churn. We almost had the same typo land again in a staging change; the new unit test caught it.

devon: Thanks everyone. If the customer sees anything odd overnight, they will reopen the ticket.
